Supported regions include all of those in the following countries: Africa South Africa APAC Australia, India, Indonesia, Japan, Korea, Singapore, Taiwan Europe Belgium, Finland, France, Germany, Italy, Netherlands, Spain, Sweden, Switzerland, United Kingdom Middle East Israel, Qatar North America Canada, Mexico, United States South America Brazil, Chile Any restrictions on the use of telecommunications services in your customer agreement are not applicable to the use of NCC's data transfer functionality in these locations.
If you want to use site-to-site-data-transfer, you must create the Network Connectivity Center (NCC) spokes in regions that support this feature.
